# Mitigators

14 registered components. Each declares an intervention category, an access level, supported architectures, the capabilities it needs from a model, and the evidence containers it consumes. Applicability is decided from those declarations by the same matcher the metrics use, and an unsatisfiable pairing is refused by name.

Access levels are ordered `black_box` < `gray_box` < `white_box`; a component declares the **minimum** it needs.

## Pre-processing

Applied to the data before training. Transform evidence, not models.

| Component | Class | Access | Architectures | Requires | Accepts |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `counterfactual_data_augmentation` | `CounterfactualDataAugmentation` | `black_box` | `decoder_only`, `encoder_decoder`, `encoder_only` | - | `CorpusWithLexicon` |
| `debiasing_prompt` | `DebiasingPrompt` | `black_box` | `decoder_only`, `encoder_decoder` | - | `PromptSpec` |
| `group_label_reweighting` | `GroupLabelReweighting` | `black_box` | `decoder_only`, `encoder_decoder`, `encoder_only` | - | `GroupLabeledRecords` |
| `identity_term_augmentation` | `IdentityTermAugmentation` | `black_box` | `decoder_only`, `encoder_decoder`, `encoder_only` | - | `CorpusWithBenignPool` |

## In-processing

Loss components composable with a normal training loop. These return a callable objective, never a trained model: there is no trainer in the core package.

| Component | Class | Access | Architectures | Requires | Accepts |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `adversarial_debiasing` | `AdversarialDebiasing` | `white_box` | `encoder_decoder`, `encoder_only` | - | `AttributeLabeledVectors`, `GroupLabeledRecords` |
| `counterfactual_invariance_loss` | `CounterfactualInvarianceLoss` | `white_box` | `encoder_only` | - | `PromptPairs` |
| `group_regularized_objective` | `GroupRegularizedObjective` | `white_box` | `encoder_only` | - | `GroupLabeledRecords` |
| `influence_guided_suppression` | `InfluenceGuidedSuppression` | `white_box` | `decoder_only` | - | `InfluenceScoredCorpus` |

## Intra-processing

Edits to a loaded model. Each returns a `ModelAdapter`, so any metric re-evaluates the mitigated model without modification.

| Component | Class | Access | Architectures | Requires | Accepts |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `iterative_nullspace_projection` | `IterativeNullspaceProjection` | `gray_box` | `encoder_decoder`, `encoder_only` | `hidden_states` | `AttributeLabeledVectors` |
| `self_debiasing` | `SelfDebiasing` | `gray_box` | `decoder_only` | `free_generation`, `token_logprobs` | `PromptSpec` |
| `subspace_projection` | `SubspaceProjection` | `gray_box` | `encoder_decoder`, `encoder_only` | `hidden_states` | `AttributeLabeledVectors`, `GroupWordPairs`, `PromptPairs` |

## Post-processing

Decision rules fitted on outputs. Serializable, and applied without the model that produced the scores.

| Component | Class | Access | Architectures | Requires | Accepts |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `group_aware_thresholding` | `GroupAwareThresholding` | `black_box` | `decoder_only`, `encoder_decoder`, `encoder_only` | - | `LabeledScoredGroups` |
| `output_reranking` | `OutputReranking` | `black_box` | `decoder_only`, `encoder_decoder` | - | `CandidateSets` |
| `score_calibration` | `ScoreCalibration` | `black_box` | `decoder_only`, `encoder_decoder`, `encoder_only` | - | `LabeledScoredGroups` |

## Not provided

Named in the paper as extension points and deliberately absent from this registry: RLHF, DPO, Constitutional AI and other preference-optimized training loops; UniDetox; the influence-estimation half of IF-Guide; GeDi, RAD, DExperts, FairSteer, ARGRE and other guided-decoding methods; LSDM; FairMed; gender-constrained beam search; model-based rewriting.

Named in the book chapter but not provided here, recorded so that a reader comparing the two does not mistake omission for oversight: conceptor debiasing; pruning and ablation; the no-attribute (name-proxy) setting; Co2PT; BiasUnlearn; data filtering and toxicity removal; dataset curation and balanced collection; output filtering and safety classification; refusal policies and content moderation; counterfactual data *substitution*. The book's bias diagnosis and data auditing family is covered, but by the [diagnostics](diagnostics.md) layer.
